specification.outcome: Normal conversation can create an ordinary Backlog task or replace an unclaimed Backlog task specification without requiring a campaign or starting work.

scenarios.name: create an ordinary task
given: create-task is closed, valid, authorized, and verified board writable
when: host locks, revalidates, atomically journals intent+tombstones+exact event bytes, signs, publishes, observes
then: one task-created-from-request projects complete initial task

scenarios.name: replace a complete backlog specification
given: specify-task has exact TaskId, complete replacement, target unclaimed Backlog
when: host binds taskVersionDigest and publishes task-specified-from-request
then: unchanged replacement follows lock/fresh-head revalidation and returns without effect authorization, IDs, or journal

scenarios.name: reject task, invocation, and ABA races
given: operation binds repository/invocation, request/event bytes, and task history
when: same task changes, invocation reused with different request, or identity has nonidentical bytes
then: conflict wins over any stored terminal result
matching journal becomes terminal only with proof

scenarios.name: retry unrelated advancement
given: journal binds stable IDs, complete bytes, expected state, attempts
then: host revalidates, records abandoned commit, transitions to intent-written, signs under new parent with same event bytes

scenarios.name: recover journal states
then: same digest/bytes returns stored terminal or continues state recovery
different digest/bytes returns publication conflict without re-execution
uncertain push remains recoverable until observed

scenarios.name: route ordinary language without partial mutation
given: user asks create, partial edit, full replacement, or create-and-start
then: create uses create-task; partial edit reconstructs complete specify-task from exposed spec; missing fields deny; create-and-start is create then separate later begin

scenarios.name: apply phase-specific failures
given: malformed input, state, authority, journal, transport, signing, conflict, or uncertainty failure
then: pre-intent denial has no journal; post-intent terminal requires local no-push proof or verified remote absence/conflict

acceptanceCriteria: Trimming is validation-only, never normalization: all bounded title and specification strings must already equal trim result and stored/canonical values are original accepted strings. Every length in this specification, including description and paths, is JavaScript UTF-16 code units. Description is not trim-validated.

Parsing/bounds: create exact kind,title,description; title 1..200 trimmed, description 0..10000. Specify exact kind,taskId,specification. Specification exact fields; outcome 1..2000; scenarios 1..50; name 1..200; step arrays 1..50 entries 1..1000; criteria/exclusions 1..100 entries 1..2000; dependencies 0..100 entries 1..2000; mappings 1..100 path strings 1..500; architecture 1..4000; canonical UTF-8 <=131072. Strings reject unpaired surrogates. Tiber receives Pi-decoded validated object and exact-key checks unknown/missing/null/undefined/wrong values.
Path is platform-independent literal slash path: no leading slash, backslash, empty segment, or '..' segment; '.' accepted; percent not decoded.

Canonical bytes are TextEncoder UTF-8 of fixed-order JSON.stringify. Create request order kind,title,description; specify kind,taskId,specification; specification order outcome,scenarios,acceptanceCriteria,exclusions,dependencies,testMappings,architectureImplications; scenario name,given,when,then; arrays preserve order.

requestDigest = sha256 lowercase hex of ASCII 'tiber-workflow-task-request-v1', zero byte, canonical request JSON. specificationDigest preserves existing sha256 canonical specification JSON without domain prefix. taskVersionDigest = sha256 lowercase hex of ASCII 'tiber-task-version-v1', zero byte, canonical JSON array of ordered affecting event IDs. All serialize as 'sha256:'+hex.

Task-version-affecting means exactly every accepted event whose schema has task.id for creation or taskId for later authority: task-created,task-campaign-goal-created,task-created-from-request,task-specified,task-specified-from-request,task-ready,task-claimed,task-claim-taken-over,task-increment-preserved,task-final-review-recorded,task-delivery-recorded,task-ci-recorded,task-review-opened,task-review-recorded,task-claim-released,task-completed. IDs are ordered by verified linear single-parent commit ancestry then event array index. Merge/multi-parent history degrades read-only.
TaskId accepts lowercase canonical UUID v1..5 RFC variant. Generated operation/task/event IDs randomUUID v4 lowercase; occurredAt new Date(clock.now).toISOString; schemaVersion 1.

repositoryId is the generated repository UUID stored in Git common directory and already bound by setup to canonical realpath and expected remotes; path aliases resolve to the same repositoryId and mismatched path/remotes deny. invocationId = 'sha256:'+lowercase SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes ASCII 'tiber-pi-invocation-v1',zero,Pi SessionManager sessionId,zero,toolCallId. SessionId+toolCallId are persisted by Pi and stable for resumed execution; fresh calls differ.

Creation event fixed order schemaVersion,eventId,kind,occurredAt,operationId,invocationId,requestDigest,task(id,title,description). Initial projection Backlog/unblocked, all Option evidence/claim/campaign fields none, increments empty, no Ready rank/priority; order linear history/event index.

Specification event fixed order schemaVersion,eventId,kind,occurredAt,operationId,invocationId,requestDigest,taskId,expectedTaskVersionDigest,specificationDigest,specification. Projection rejects duplicate IDs, existing task creation, or wrong version/lifecycle/digest/request/canonical bytes.

Unchanged phase order is parse -> local verified board -> find task -> validate unclaimed Backlog -> compare bytes+digest -> acquire repository lock -> fetch fresh verified remote -> recompute task existence/lifecycle/version/bytes/digest -> return unchanged if exact, else lifecycle/conflict. Because no effect follows, signer/publisher authorization, generated IDs, and journal are not requested.

Before intent, create generates operation/task/event triple and amend operation/event pair; check complete history and retained records; regenerate whole tuple max three. Discarded collision tuples need no tombstone because already occupied. Collision-free IDs are tombstoned in the same atomic intent record. No v1 tombstone GC.

Journal record fixed schema: schemaVersion,repositoryId,invocationId,operation,operationId,requestDigest,taskId Option,eventId,expectedTaskVersionDigest Option,eventBytesBase64,state,attempts,terminal Option. intent-written transition atomically introduces operation plus all generated-ID tombstones in one locked temp-write,file-fsync,rename,directory-fsync; there is no separate crash window. Retained terminal records are the tombstone index.

Recovery selects repositoryId+invocationId before digest. Same digest+bytes resumes/returns receipt-recorded or terminal-denied exactly. Different digest/bytes returns PUBLICATION_CONFLICT even if record terminal, preserving original record.

Graph success intent-written->commit-prepared->push-attempted->observed-published->receipt-recorded. Unrelated proven-absent head advancement appends attempt and returns to intent-written. receipt/denied terminal. Journal I/O leaves last durable state and recovery never assumes transition.

Post-intent local no-publication proof is either signing failed before any push call, or transport adapter returned typed not-attempted/definitely-not-sent; these may terminal-deny after fresh verified head confirms IDs absent. Unknown/possibly-sent remains push-attempted. Conflicting remote identity/bytes terminal-denies after verified observation. No other post-intent failure becomes terminal.

Events are JSON in Git tree; commit signs tree,parent,author,committer,message. Unrelated retry same event bytes/IDs but new parent/commit/signature. Prepared local commit is audit not published authority.

Phase mapping: invalid local signed projection BOARD_READ_ONLY. Remote fetch failure before intent PUBLICATION_FAILED with no journal. Fetch/observation after push PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN retaining push-attempted. Lock conflict PUBLICATION_CONFLICT. Missing authority PUBLICATION_UNAUTHORIZED. Signing attempt failure SIGNING_FAILED. Definitively unsent transport PUBLICATION_FAILED.

Pre-intent effectful phase for changed operations: parse/local board/task/lifecycle -> signer/publisher authority -> lock -> remote refresh -> collision/tombstone -> event construction -> locked revalidation -> atomic intent+tombstones. Signing/push only after intent. Unchanged follows its separate no-effect sequence.
Published/reconciled boardHead is exact event-introducing commit; reconciliation verifies current head descends from it. Unchanged boardHead current fresh verified head.

Precedence create: WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID,TASK_VALUE_INVALID,TASK_BOARD_READ_ONLY,TASK_PUBLICATION_UNAUTHORIZED,TASK_PUBLICATION_FAILED prefetch,TASK_JOURNAL_IO,TASK_ID_COLLISION,TASK_SIGNING_FAILED,TASK_PUBLICATION_FAILED,TASK_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT,TASK_PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN. Amend inserts TASK_ID_INVALID,SPECIFICATION_INVALID,TASK_NOT_FOUND,TASK_LIFECYCLE_INVALID,SPECIFICATION_UNCHANGED before changed-effect authorization.

Retry metadata: input errors retry-after-input corrected input; board/notfound/lifecycle/auth/conflict retry-after-state-change with writable board/existing task/unclaimed Backlog/configured authority/fresh board; collision/journal/signing/transport transient with fresh IDs/repaired journal/retry signing/retry transport; uncertain transient exact remote observation.

Receipts dispositions published,reconciled,unchanged. Create TIBER_TASK_CREATED eventId some, event boardHead,digest none. Amend TIBER_TASK_SPECIFIED eventId/digest some. Unchanged eventId none,current digest some. Denials expose code,operation,exact taskId Option,retryability,evidence.
Ordinary operations never promote, prioritize, review, claim, start, or alter campaign state.
dependencies: canonical specification exposure for partial edits
specification.architectureImplications: Add closed create/specify requests, request-bound events, domain-separated request/task-version digests, canonical Unicode/bounds, linear history, and durable repo operation records/tombstones. Host owns parsing, lock, IDs, lifecycle/ABA checks, signing after intent/revalidation, uncertainty observation, receipts; inference grants no authority/start.
